REST API¶

The REST API uses Django REST Framework and token authentication. Replace YOUR_TOKEN with the real token for your account.

Common endpoints¶

  • POST /api/token/: get a login token.

  • GET /api/articles/: list approved articles (login needed).

  • POST /api/articles/: submit an article (Journalist only).

  • GET /api/articles/<id>/: get a story visible to your role.

  • PUT/PATCH/DELETE /api/articles/<id>/: edit or remove a permitted story.

  • GET /api/articles/subscribed/: the Reader’s approved subscribed content.

  • POST /api/approved/: signed internal approval notice (not a public action).

Example request header:

Authorization: Token YOUR_TOKEN

A Reader cannot see pending stories or create articles. Journalists cannot approve their own articles. The API checks a signed header before accepting approval messages, so a normal user cannot approve a story using that route.

If you receive 401 or 403, check that the token and account role are correct. Invalid form data should give a validation error.
